name: How long does a custom fine woodworking project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom fine woodworking project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom fine woodworking project depends on its scope and intricacy. Smaller pieces or straightforward designs might be completed in a few weeks, while large-scale custom cabinetry or complex installations could take several months. During our initial planning phase, we establish a clear timeline for your specific project, including design, material acquisition, crafting, and installation. We work to meet agreed-upon deadlines while prioritizing quality craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary by scope; smaller projects take weeks, larger ones months. We establish a clear timeline during planning.
